what: Design of record for the presentation-layer wave: notation audit over the 34 landed CIE canonical bundles, damage-class census, three-lane repair architecture (R1 render / R2 geometry re-recovery / R3 polish), transform tables with inverses, gate law, T2 execution plan.
inputs_of_record: commit d926be489c016d55b6d5bd3c9210b4d19b5acaf4 (68 bundle files; blob oids via cache/w-exec/manifest-wf3t2-land.json)
cache/w-f5/audit-of-record.json (pattern inventory P01..P15 + damage_classes_refined, per-qual counts + examples)

audit_verdict.corpus_health: typographically healthy overall; 327 rows already carry correct unicode math
audit_verdict.key_finding: flags of record undercount the loss class (5 rows flagged possible-superscript-loss vs 54 rows evidenced by sub/super/orphan detectors); flags stay untouched, repairs derive from evidence and are receipted per-row

lanes.R1: text_render on every row (KaTeX $..$ spans + safe normalizations); text never modified; pure ordered transform table

lanes.R3: render-side polish (footer strip, degree/prime spacing, geometry-proven hyphen rejoin); reversible, receipted

design.issue_law: 34 spec_points.json re-issued at issue 2 with one added field text_render (14 fields); topics.json byte-identical; flags additive-only; counts recomputed; census 0.6 rider only if census schema describes the bumped fields
design.transform_tables: accepted T1-T6 with recorded guards + inverses; chem-bare/ion-charge/ordinal/whole-text-LaTeX REJECTED (false-positive-prone or garbled-source classes -> R2 evidence only); ambiguity law: unadjudicable instances stay verbatim
gates_T2: G-F5-C5 swap discipline (34 modified files, one revertible commit, sha256 pins)

G-F5-D1.evidence: every transform guard cites the audit examples (cache/w-f5/audit-of-record.json) or pinned bundle blobs via manifest-wf3t2-land.json oids; lane rules cite the W-F2 reparse precedent and provenance pins
